background_tasks.description: Wait for phone deployment and verify state flips to alive
background_tasks.command: D=/Users/noir/Projects/t33a-remapper; end=$((SECONDS+400)); while [ $SECONDS -lt $end ]; do V=$(adb -s 192.168.0.18:5555 shell "grep -c 'REMOTE_STATE' /sdcard/Download/t33a_boot.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); S=$(adb -s 192.168.0.18:5555 shell "cat /sdcard/Download/t33a_remote_state" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) REMOTE_STATE참조=$V state=$S"; [ "$V" -ge 6 ] 2>/dev/null && [ "$S" = "alive" ] && { echo "배포+복구판정 확인"; break; }; sleep 30; done
e=$((SECONDS+120)); while [ $SECONDS -lt $e ]; do sleep 20; done; tail -3 /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-noir/28d5bd0e-abf9-4a66-bc8a-6ba62e9582e1/tasks/b8gczlwm3.output
